query: Why have I become so cynical?

per_question.q: Which page leaves the reader more in charge of changing this?
per_question.why: In Page A, the seminar callout is kept outside and below the identify box, leaving the core diagnostic observation intact and unbranded, which keeps the reader focused on self-reflection rather than being funneled into a program.

per_question.q: Which page asks less of the reader before it has earned it?
per_question.why: Page B embeds an external promotional link directly inside the introductory self-identification callout box before the reader has even engaged with the body text, whereas Page A lets the identification box finish cleanly.

per_question.q: Which page treats the reader as the person who does the work, rather than as someone who has to be sent somewhere?
per_question.why: Page A keeps the identify box purely about the reader's internal monologue without appending an immediate seminar upsell right inside the box.

per_question.q: Which page gives the reader more room to decide for themselves what to do next?
per_question.why: Keeping the seminar link separate beneath the identify box in Page A allows the reader to sit with the four diagnostic sentences without an embedded programmatic push.

per_question.q: Which page puts the author's own history to better use for the reader?
per_question.why: Both pages share identical author narrative in the body, but Page A frames the reader's self-inquiry cleanly up front before linking to author offerings.

per_question.q: Which page makes the first screen feel more like the reader's own words?
per_question.why: In Page A, the identify box concludes entirely on the impact of the reader's standing policy ('Run those as a standing policy and the cost is a read on people that no person can change.'), rather than ending on seminar promotion.

per_question.q: Which page's opening is easier to read straight through without being interrupted?
per_question.why: Page B interrupts the rhythm of the identify box by placing a promotional seminar link inside the container right after the closing sentence, making it feel like an ad block.

per_question.q: Which page makes a reader likelier to think "that is me" in the first thirty seconds?
per_question.why: Page A preserves the resonance of the identify box by letting the four recognizable sentences stand without marketing clutter inside the container.

per_question.q: Which page keeps its argument moving without a detour that breaks the thread?
per_question.why: Page B consolidates the seminar link into the callout box, leaving the transition from the box to the friend narrative on the main page surface slightly cleaner.

per_question.q: Which page makes it easier to follow the line from the question at the top to the answer?
per_question.why: Page B confines all introductory callout elements within defined boxes, keeping the flow into the prose story marginally more contained.

A: Leaves a standalone link sitting naked between the callout box and the opening narrative paragraph.
B: Contaminates the reader identification box with promotional seminar copy before building trust.

first_screen: Page A leaves the reader more in charge because the identify box ends on the reader's own psychological reality rather than terminating with a link to an external seminar.
provenance: Both pages are identical in their citations, scientific references, and personal history disclosures.
